intent: A Victorian-gothic mourning gown in black broadcloth with a violet-framed stained-glass stomacher, a lace collar and bell sleeves, read from the high camera as a narrow lace waist over a wide tiered bell skirt beneath a steepled hat ringed with amber candle stubs and a black lace veil.
